blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The University of the Philippines Rural High School (UPRHS) has strongly condemned the red-tagging of the institution and its constituents over its commemoration of the 54th anniversary of martial law last month. In a statement released Thursday, UPRHS said a social media post published by the Facebook account identified as “Emjay Chico” and shared by “Lorraine Baddie” (Lorraine Badoy) alleged that high school students were used in a political activity on school premises. The photos in the post were first published by The Ruralite, the school’s official student publication, to show how UPRHS marked the UP Day of […]...
